verified_title: Guess and Send: World-Model-Guided Semantic Packet Transmission for Robust Video Perception
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2610.29587: Guess and Send: World-Model-Guided Semantic Packet Transmission for Robust Video Perception
method_summary: An ACK-synchronized receiver twin tracks only delivered semantic packets. A world model compares all-refresh and prediction-only counterfactuals from the same receiver memory to prioritize packet content. QPSK and Sionna-calibrated 5G-NR LDPC curves define codeword success/erasure; complete frame outage uses a defined fallback rather than unverified residual updates.
evidence_and_limits: Video perception/semantic packet transmission, not Wi-Fi roaming or deadline-hazard inference. Its fallback and delivered-state synchronization overlap directly with claims that those broad mechanisms are new.
